switcher.title: Recommended Setup: Freedom (Cross-Device Distraction Blocker)
switcher.desc: Locks distracting websites and apps simultaneously on desktop and phone so willpower isn't wasted fighting impulse clicks.

overplanner.title: Recommended Setup: Motion (AI Time-Blocking Calendar)
overplanner.desc: Automatically schedules tasks into realistic open hours on your calendar and warns you the moment your day is overbooked.

mood_dodger.title: Recommended Setup: Todoist (Ultra-Light 2-Min Capture)
mood_dodger.desc: Keep today's view down to just 1–3 tiny next actions so your brain doesn't panic at a wall of overdue projects.

daydreamer.title: Recommended Setup: Focus & Habit Reset System
daydreamer.desc: Pair your daily target with concrete obstacles and WOOP if-then triggers so planning turns into shipped output.
